project.name: Digital South English Legendary
project.description: System for processing scanned Middle English manuscripts and using ML to transcribe hand-written cursive texts
project.author: William Bolton

domain.subject: South English Legendary - collection of saints' lives in Middle English
domain.sourceType: Scanned images of hand-written Middle English manuscripts in cursive script
domain.challenge: Word-level handwriting recognition (OCR not viable for cursive)

phases.name: Image Preprocessing & Dataset Creation

steps.name: Image Organization
steps.description: Copy and structure scanned images with manuscript page metadata

steps.name: Computer Vision Processing
steps.description: Detect words on pages, extract word images, create training database

phases.deliverable: Word image database for model training

phases.name: Model Training & Iterative Improvement

steps.name: Model Development
steps.description: Train word-level recognition model on Middle English cursive

steps.name: Annotation Interface
steps.description: Web interface for human verification and correction of predictions

phases.deliverable: Trained model with page-level transcription capability

phases.name: Text Refinement & Publication

steps.name: Post-Processing Editing
steps.description: Clean and refine transcribed pages with iterative model improvement

steps.name: Scholarly Edition
steps.description: Multi-version web application for scholarly text publication

phases.deliverable: Public scholarly edition of transcribed texts

designPrinciples: SOLID Principles (Single Responsibility, Open/Closed, Liskov Substitution, Interface Segregation, Dependency Inversion)

architectureNotes: Transfer handles image organization (Phase 1, Step 1) - Single Responsibility Principle
Preprocessor handles word extraction (Phase 1, Step 2) - Single Responsibility Principle
Both classes follow consistent interface: validate(), run(), _process_file() methods
Full type hints throughout for IDE support and error detection
CLI commands wrap class exceptions with ClickException for user-friendly error messages
I/O logic will be separated into services/ directory for modularity
Services directory for business logic (cv_processing.py for word detection, etc.)
Extensible Click group structure enables easy addition of future commands
Each command corresponds to a specific phase/step in the workflow
